# Homepage hero photographs

Four user-supplied JPEG photographs were copied byte-for-byte from the Pictures folder. Originals remain untouched. The homepage uses only these four local photos, in numeric order. Responsive object-position values adjust the display crop without modifying the files.

- `Front landing1.jpeg` → `front-landing-1.jpeg`; SHA-256 `e481a31ade19bf5f0271901640e5cc6027074d4ddef810df299587d7e8bb96c7`
- `front landing 2.jpeg` → `front-landing-2.jpeg`; SHA-256 `bfe851ffd61769c7081da61055346bcf826b0321b3a20ae99659aa460583edc0`
- `front landing 3.jpeg` → `front-landing-3.jpeg`; SHA-256 `e80bf746608a3b6c90d6cc4c7ba101a74209f7c2cb9605dd20529dfc547cd6dc`
- `front landing 4.jpeg` → `front-landing-4.jpeg`; SHA-256 `066bf129419e6d577d623cd8ae680c8e8614205f65c85a9ad0835a5d13870d06`

Earlier placeholder SVGs are retained but unused. Source photographer and licence documents were not supplied; no licensing claim is made.
